properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-08-23: this is the BACKLOG, not a hole. These requirements are recorded forward work and the trace should keep showing them until something delivers them; dropping them to shorten the list would trade a commitment record for a to-do list. Reviewed as a class rather than one at a time, and the review expires per requirement if its text changes, so a requirement that is quietly re-scoped comes back to be judged again.
